standard_prerequisites.name: On an affine scheme the coherator functor agrees with taking the quasi-coherent sheaf associated to global derived sections, by the affine comparison and affine coherator lemmas
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives the affine case with N = 0.

standard_prerequisites.name: The induction principle for quasi-compact opens
standard_prerequisites.use: Organizes the reduction from U, V, and U cap V to X.

standard_prerequisites.name: The pushforwards along the quasi-compact open immersions have finite cohomological dimension on D_QCoh, by the quasi-coherence direct image lemma
standard_prerequisites.use: Bounds the extra cohomological spread introduced by pushing the pieces back to X.

standard_prerequisites.name: The coherator Mayer-Vietoris distinguished triangle of the preceding remark
standard_prerequisites.use: Assembles the vanishing on the pieces into vanishing on X.

core_obligations: Affine case: if X is affine, DQ_X is given by the quasi-coherent sheaf associated to R Gamma(X, K) by the affine comparison and affine coherator lemmas, so H^i(DQ_X(K)) = H^i(R Gamma(X, K)) vanishes outside [a, b] and N = 0 works (proof lines 5189-5193).

Induction setup: assume the property holds for quasi-compact opens U, V and U cap V with constants N(U), N(V), N(U cap V); for K with H^i(W, K) = 0 outside [a, b] on all affine W, the restrictions K|_U, K|_V, K|_{U cap V} inherit the property, so their coherated images vanish outside [a, b + max of the three constants] (proof lines 5195-5200).

Conclude: the pushforwards Rj_{U,*}, Rj_{V,*}, Rj_{U cap V,*} have finite cohomological dimension on D_QCoh by the quasi-coherence direct image lemma, so a single N absorbs the spread of all three pieces, and the coherator Mayer-Vietoris triangle of remark-explain-consequence gives the vanishing of H^i(DQ_X(K)) outside [a, b + N] (proof lines 5201-5212).
proof_roadmap: Settle the affine case with N = 0 (proof lines 5189-5193).
Carry the vanishing from U, V and U cap V to their coherated pushforwards (proof lines 5195-5200).
Absorb the pushforward spread with a uniform N and conclude by the coherator triangle (proof lines 5201-5212).
difficulty_reason: 30 行、induction principle 标准套路：①仿射情形 N=0：DQ_X 由 RΓ(X,K) 的伴随拟凝聚层给出（affine-compare + affine-coherator 引理），区间不变；②归纳步：K 在所有仿射开上区间 [a,b] 外消失 ⇒ 三个限制继承 ⇒ 各自 coherate 后在 [a, b+max(N(U),N(V),N(U∩V))] 外消失；③三个包含态射的 Rj_* 在 D_QCoh 上有有限上同调维数（quasi-coherence-direct-image 引理，本线 L22123）⇒ 统一吸收成 N；④用前一个 remark 的 coherator Mayer-Vietoris 三角把三块的消失合成 X 上的消失。承重全在 span 内；6 处引用（4 同章、2 跨章）作导航桩。
